GURO WARNING!!!!

I have started a series of stories about what you can read in this few page intro. My plan is to tell fully developed superhero stories and push the boundaries of imagination using the tools that AI provides. These will be complete narratives, not just a few random photos and spectacular images. I want to make them dramatic, psychologically insightful, and impactful stuff with as realistic and human characters as it can get. If you have any story ideas, feel free to share them—let’s see what we can bring to life together.
If you have any technical advises, it's also appriciated.
